questions.question_hindi:
एक व्यापक “स्कूल रिकॉर्ड प्रबंधन”
     प्रणाली एक प्रबंधकीय कार्य के रूप में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि
     यह:
options_hindi:
पुराने कागजी रिकॉर्ड के व्यवस्थित पुनर्चक्रण और बिक्री के माध्यम से
         अतिरिक्त संस्थागत राजस्व उत्पन्न करती है

ऐतिहासिक निरंतरता, वैधानिक अनुपालन, और डेटा-संचालित निर्णय-
         लेने को सुनिश्चित करती है

गैर-शिक्षण प्रशासनिक लिपिक कर्मचारियों को स्कूल की छुट्टियों के दौरान
         नियमित फाइलिंग में व्यस्त रखती है

प्रशासकों द्वारा छात्र की बौद्धिक क्षमता को ग्रेडिंग के लिए
         उपयोग की जाने वाली प्राथमिक आधिकारिक मानदंड के रूप में कार्य करती है

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: A comprehensive 'School Record Management' system is essential as a managerial function because it:
options_english: Generates additional institutional revenue through the systematic recycling and sale of old paper records
Ensures historical continuity, statutory compliance, and data-driven decision-making
Keeps non-teaching administrative clerical staff actively busy with routine filing during school holidays
Serves as the primary official criterion utilized by administrators for grading student intellectual ability
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option B. A comprehensive school record management system is crucial for ensuring historical continuity, compliance with legal requirements, and facilitating data-driven decision-making. Option A is incorrect because generating revenue through recycling is not the primary purpose of a school record management system. Option C is misleading as keeping staff busy does not contribute to effective management. Option D is also incorrect as grading student intellectual ability is based on assessments, not record management.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक व्यापक स्कूल रिकॉर्ड प्रबंधन प्रणाली ऐतिहासिक निरंतरता, वैधानिक अनुपालन, और डेटा-संचालित निर्णय लेने को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि पुनर्चक्रण के माध्यम से राजस्व उत्पन्न करना स्कूल रिकॉर्ड प्रबंधन प्रणाली का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य नहीं है। विकल्प (c) भ्रामक है क्योंकि कर्मचारियों को व्यस्त रखना प्रभावी प्रबंधन में योगदान नहीं करता। विकल्प (d) भी गलत है क्योंकि छात्र की बौद्धिक क्षमता का ग्रेडिंग मूल्यांकन पर आधारित होता है, रिकॉर्ड प्रबंधन पर नहीं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Ensures historical continuity, statutory compliance, and data-driven decision-making

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A comprehensive school record management system is vital for ensuring institutional continuity, legal compliance, and data-driven decision-making.

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को
      'Assertion (A)' और दूसरे को
      'Reason (R)' के रूप में लेबल किया गया है।
      Assertion (A): स्थिति नेतृत्व सिद्धांत के अनुसार,
      एक प्रधान को एक अत्यधिक अनुभवी और
      अत्यधिक प्रेरित शिक्षक के साथ
      'निर्देशित' (बताने वाला) शैली का उपयोग करना चाहिए।
      Reason (R): अत्यधिक सक्षम और प्रतिबद्ध
      स्टाफ को यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए सख्त
      निगरानी की आवश्यकता होती है कि वे
      पाठ्यक्रम से भटक न जाएं।
options_hindi:
A और R दोनों सत्य हैं और R, A का सही
          स्पष्टीकरण है

A और R दोनों सत्य हैं लेकिन R, A का
          सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है
A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Class Observation and School Supervision

questions.question_english:
Consider the following two statements: one is labeled
      as Assertion (A) and the other as
      Reason (R).
      Assertion (A): According to Situational
      Leadership Theory, a Principal should adopt
      a 'Directing' (telling) style with a highly
      experienced and highly motivated teacher.
      Reason (R): Highly competent and committed
      staff require strict oversight to ensure they do
      not deviate from the syllabus.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: In the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model, a directing style is inappropriate for highly experienced and motivated staff, making the assertion false. Administrators should instead utilize a delegating approach. However, administrative frameworks acknowledge that regulatory oversight remains necessary across all employee cadres to ensure continuous compliance with mandatory curriculum guidelines.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। स्थिति नेतृत्व सिद्धांत के अनुसार, अत्यधिक अनुभवी और प्रेरित शिक्षकों के लिए 'निर्देशित' शैली का उपयोग करना अनुचित है, जिससे यह कथन असत्य है। इसके बजाय, प्रशासकों को एक प्रतिनिधि दृष्टिकोण अपनाना चाहिए। हालाँकि, प्रशासनिक ढांचे यह मानते हैं कि सभी कर्मचारियों के लिए पाठ्यक्रम दिशानिर्देशों के निरंतर अनुपालन को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए नियामक निगरानी आवश्यक है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model, a directing style is inappropriate for highly experienced and motivated staff, making the assertion false.

आधिकारिक सेवा पुस्तक में संचयी

questions.question_english:
Which of the following best describes the
     “Feedforward” mechanism in educational
     supervision?
options_english:
Systematically analyzing past instructional
         mistakes primarily to assign administrative
         blame

Providing guidance and strategies focused
         on future performance and improvement

Documenting and recording cumulative
         historical service data in the official service
         book

Communicating exclusively with parents
         regarding a teacher’s annual classroom
         performance
questions.explanation_english:
The feedforward mechanism in educational
       supervision shifts analytical focus from past
       mistakes to future performance enhancement.
       Instead of diagnosing historical errors or issuing
       retrospective criticisms, supervisors provide
       actionable forward-looking strategies and
       guidance, empowering teachers to anticipate
       potential challenges and refine their instructional
       practices in upcoming teaching sessions.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। शिक्षण पर्यवेक्षण में फीडफॉरवर्ड तंत्र
       भूतकाल की गलतियों से भविष्य के प्रदर्शन में सुधार पर
       ध्यान केंद्रित करता है। ऐतिहासिक त्रुटियों का निदान करने या
       पूर्ववर्ती आलोचनाएँ करने के बजाय, पर्यवेक्षक कार्यान्वयन योग्य
       भविष्य की रणनीतियाँ और मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करते हैं, जिससे
       शिक्षकों को संभावित चुनौतियों का अनुमान लगाने और आगामी
       शिक्षण सत्रों में अपनी शिक्षण प्रथाओं को परिष्कृत करने का
       अधिकार मिलता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Providing guidance and strategies focused
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The feedforward mechanism in educational supervision shifts analytical focus from past mistakes to future performance enhancement.

questions.question_english: Which of the following records is classified as a permanent record in a school and must never be destroyed?
options_english: Casual Leave register and staff absence records
Admission and Withdrawal (Scholar’s) Register
Daily attendance register of enrolled classroom students
Equipment issue register of the physical sports department
questions.explanation_english: The Admission and Withdrawal Register, commonly known as the Scholar’s Register, is a permanent statutory record that must be preserved indefinitely by the school. It contains crucial historical demographic data, enrollment dates, parentage, and withdrawal details for every student, serving as legal verification of educational attendance and personal identity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्रवेश और निकासी रजिस्टर, जिसे स्कॉलर का रजिस्टर कहा जाता है, एक स्थायी वैधानिक रिकॉर्ड है जिसे स्कूल द्वारा अनिश्चितकाल तक संरक्षित किया जाना चाहिए। इसमें प्रत्येक छात्र के लिए महत्वपूर्ण ऐतिहासिक जनसांख्यिकीय डेटा, नामांकन तिथियाँ, माता-पिता की जानकारी और निकासी विवरण होते हैं, जो शैक्षणिक उपस्थिति और व्यक्तिगत पहचान का कानूनी सत्यापन प्रदान करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Admission and Withdrawal (Scholar’s)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Admission and Withdrawal Register, commonly known as the Scholar’s Register, is a permanent statutory record that must be preserved indefinitely by the school.

questions.question_english: Which of the following serves as a strong indicator of a 'Toxic School Culture'?
options_english: Teachers openly discussing complex instructional challenges with peers and actively seeking pedagogical help
High levels of staff fragmentation, complaining, and blaming students for failure
Frequent collaborative professional development workshops and structured interdisciplinary learning sessions
Enthusiastically celebrating all academic, artistic, and extracurricular achievements of diverse student cohorts
questions.explanation_english: A toxic school culture is characterized by pervasive negativity, professional isolation, staff fragmentation, and a widespread refusal to accept academic responsibility. In such dysfunctional environments, faculty members frequently complain, express cynicism, blame students or parents for educational shortcomings, and resist collaborative efforts designed to improve teaching practices and learning outcomes.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। विषाक्त स्कूल संस्कृति व्यापक नकारात्मकता, पेशेवर अलगाव, स्टाफ विखंडन, और शैक्षणिक जिम्मेदारी को स्वीकार करने से इनकार करने की विशेषता होती है। ऐसे असामान्य वातावरण में, संकाय सदस्य अक्सर शिकायत करते हैं, निराशा व्यक्त करते हैं, छात्रों या माता-पिता को शैक्षणिक कमियों के लिए दोषी ठहराते हैं, और शिक्षण प्रथाओं और सीखने के परिणामों में सुधार के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए सहयोगात्मक प्रयासों का विरोध करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) High levels of staff fragmentation, complaining, and blaming students for failure

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A toxic school culture is characterized by pervasive negativity, professional isolation, staff fragmentation, and a widespread refusal to accept academic responsibility.

questions.question_english: The approach of 'Democratic Supervision' is grounded in the belief that:
options_english: The supervisor inherently knows best and classroom teachers should merely execute administrative orders
Teachers are self-directed professionals, making improvement a collaborative effort
Formal instructional supervision and administrative oversight are entirely unnecessary in educational systems
Institutional policy decisions should always be determined by a simple majority vote among enrolled students
questions.explanation_english: Democratic supervision is grounded in the conviction that teachers are reflective, self-directed professionals capable of continuous self-improvement. Fostering egalitarian administrative relationships, democratic supervision treats instructional enhancement as a collaborative, ongoing process built on mutual respect, shared decision-making, supportive coaching, and constructive dialogic feedback between supervisors and teaching staff.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण इस विश्वास पर आधारित है कि शिक्षक आत्म-निर्देशित पेशेवर होते हैं, जो सुधार को एक सहयोगात्मक प्रयास बनाते हैं। यह दृष्टिकोण शिक्षकों की निरंतर आत्म-सुधार की क्षमता पर जोर देता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Teachers are self-directed professionals,

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Democratic supervision is grounded in the conviction that teachers are reflective, self-directed professionals capable of continuous self-improvement.

questions.question_english:
Evaluate the following statements regarding the observation phase in clinical supervision:
I. The supervisor should intervene and take control of the class if the teacher makes a conceptual error.
II. The supervisor should document descriptive, non-judgmental data about classroom events.
III. The observation should concentrate on the areas agreed upon during the pre-observation conference.
IV. The supervisor should remain inconspicuous to minimize disruption to the learning environment.
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: Only I, II, and III
Only II, III, and IV
Only I, III, and IV
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: During classroom observation, the supervisor maintains a non-intrusive presence to avoid disrupting student learning or undermining the teacher’s authority. The focus remains on collecting objective, non-judgmental data concerning agreed-upon instructional elements. Intervening or taking over the class during instruction damages professional trust and invalidates the authentic observation process.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। कक्षा के अवलोकन के दौरान, पर्यवेक्षक को छात्रों के सीखने में व्यवधान डालने या शिक्षक की अधिकारिता को कमजोर करने से बचने के लिए एक गैर-हस्तक्षेपकारी उपस्थिति बनाए रखनी चाहिए। ध्यान सहमति व्यक्त किए गए शैक्षणिक तत्वों के बारे में वस्तुनिष्ठ, गैर-निर्णायक डेटा एकत्र करने पर रहता है। शिक्षण के दौरान हस्तक्षेप करना या कक्षा को अपने नियंत्रण में लेना पेशेवर विश्वास को नुकसान पहुंचाता है और वास्तविक अवलोकन प्रक्रिया को अमान्य करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Only II, III, and IV
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The supervisor maintains a non-intrusive presence to avoid disrupting student learning.

questions.question_hindi: शिक्षक मूल्यांकन (APAR) करने में एक सामान्य गलती “केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति त्रुटि” है, जो तब होती है जब रिपोर्टिंग अधिकारी:
options_hindi:
लगभग सभी शिक्षकों को “औसत” के रूप में रेट करता है ताकि
         चरम स्कोर (उच्च या निम्न) को सही ठहराने से बचा जा सके

हर मूल्यांकित शिक्षक को सभी मूल्यांकन मेट्रिक्स में
         अत्यधिक उच्च प्रदर्शन रेटिंग देता है

एक शिक्षक का मूल्यांकन और रेटिंग केवल उनके हाल के कक्षा

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: A common pitfall in conducting teacher appraisals (APAR) is the 'Central Tendency Error,' which occurs when the reporting officer:
options_english: Rates almost all teachers as 'average' to avoid having to justify extreme scores (high or low)
Generously gives every evaluated teacher extremely high performance ratings across all appraisal metrics
Harshly gives every evaluated teacher extremely low performance ratings across all appraisal metrics
Evaluates and rates a teacher based exclusively on their most recent classroom performance behavior
questions.explanation_english: The central tendency error in performance appraisal occurs when an evaluating officer rates almost all employees around the middle or average of a rating scale. Administrators commit this error to avoid justifying extreme high or low marks, resulting in distorted performance appraisals that fail to recognize outstanding achievements or address underperformance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति त्रुटि तब होती है जब मूल्यांकन अधिकारी लगभग सभी शिक्षकों को औसत के रूप में रेट करता है ताकि चरम स्कोर (उच्च या निम्न) को सही ठहराने से बचा जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Rates almost all teachers as 'average' to avoid having to justify extreme scores (high or low)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The central tendency error in performance appraisal occurs when an evaluating officer rates almost all employees around the middle or average of a rating scale.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following functions of the School Management Committee (SMC) as mandated by the RTE Act:
I. Monitoring the functioning of the school.
II. Preparing and recommending the School Development Plan.
III. Appointing regular government teachers to fill vacancies.
Which of the statements above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: Under the RTE Act 2009, School Management Committees hold statutory responsibilities including monitoring school functioning, overseeing grant utilization, and preparing annual School Development Plans. However, SMCs do not possess legal authority to recruit or appoint regular government school teachers, which remains the sole domain of state educational authorities and service commissions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। RTE अधिनियम 2009 के तहत, स्कूल प्रबंधन समितियों के पास स्कूल के कार्य की निगरानी, अनुदान के उपयोग की निगरानी, और वार्षिक स्कूल विकास योजनाएँ तैयार करने की वैधानिक जिम्मेदारियाँ होती हैं। हालाँकि, SMCs के पास नियमित सरकारी स्कूल शिक्षकों की नियुक्ति करने का कानूनी अधिकार नहीं है, जो राज्य शैक्षिक प्राधिकरणों और सेवा आयोगों का विशेष क्षेत्र है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the RTE Act 2009, School Management Committees hold statutory responsibilities including monitoring school functioning, overseeing grant utilization, and preparing annual School Development Plans.

          head of the institution.

II, III, and IV only

questions.explanation_english:
The school log book is an official permanent

questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। स्कूल का लॉग बुक एक आधिकारिक स्थायी

     अधिकारियों की आधिकारिक टिप्पणियों को दस्तावेजित करने
     के लिए बनाए रखा जाता है। यह संस्थागत प्रगति और

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II, and IV only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The school log book is an official permanent record maintained by the principal to document significant events, institutional visits, administrative milestones, and official remarks.

राज्य शिक्षा अधिनियम में प्रलेखित औपचारिक वैधानिक नियम और नियामक आदेश

questions.question_english: School climate is often distinguished from school culture. While school culture refers to deeply embedded norms, values, and traditions, school climate pertains to:
options_english: The local physical weather and meteorological conditions affecting regular student attendance
The formal statutory rules and regulatory mandates documented in the state education act
The daily feel or atmosphere of the school as perceived by students and staff
The cumulative historical academic performance of the institution in official board examinations
questions.explanation_english: School climate describes the psychological atmosphere, operational feel, and social experience within an institution as perceived by students, teachers, and community members. While school culture consists of historical values and deeply rooted traditions, climate reflects immediate environmental perceptions regarding interpersonal relationships, administrative fairness, safety, and institutional support.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। स्कूल जलवायु मनोवैज्ञानिक वातावरण, संचालन की भावना और एक संस्थान के भीतर सामाजिक अनुभव का वर्णन करती है जैसा कि छात्रों, शिक्षकों और समुदाय के सदस्यों द्वारा अनुभव किया जाता है। जबकि स्कूल संस्कृति ऐतिहासिक मूल्यों और गहराई से निहित परंपराओं से बनी होती है, जलवायु तत्काल पर्यावरणीय धारणाओं को दर्शाती है जो अंतरव्यक्तिगत संबंधों, प्रशासनिक निष्पक्षता, सुरक्षा और संस्थागत समर्थन के संबंध में होती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) The daily feel or atmosphere of the school

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: School climate describes the psychological atmosphere, operational feel, and social experience within an institution as perceived by students, teachers, and community members.

     made through mutual consultation?

questions.explanation_english:
Democratic supervision relies on collaborative,
    egalitarian relationships between supervisors
    and teaching personnel. Under this approach,
    the supervisor acts as a facilitator and advisor
    rather than an authoritarian ruler. Operational
    decisions, curriculum improvements, and
    instructional goals are established through

    problem-solving, fostering high staff morale and
    professional independence.

    पर्यवेक्षक एक सहायक और सलाहकार के रूप में कार्य करता है।
    इस दृष्टिकोण के तहत, निर्णय आपसी संवाद, आपसी सम्मान,
    और साझा समस्या समाधान के माध्यम से लिए जाते हैं,
    जो उच्च कर्मचारी मनोबल और पेशेवर स्वतंत्रता को बढ़ावा देता है।

questions.question_english: In the context of classroom observation, what does 'Wait Time' refer to?
options_english: The pause a teacher takes after asking a question before calling on a student to answer
The total duration of time the observing supervisor waits outside the classroom door before entering
The length of time taken by the classroom teacher to arrive at the room after the session bell rings
The overall duration and total length of the formal post-observation feedback conference session
questions.explanation_english: Wait time in classroom interaction refers to the intentional pause an educator maintains after posing a question before prompting student responses or calling on an individual. Extending wait time allows students adequate cognitive processing time to reflect, organize thoughts, and formulate higher-quality, analytical answers, enhancing overall student participation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कक्षा में बातचीत में वेट टाइम उस जानबूझकर विराम को संदर्भित करता है जो एक शिक्षक प्रश्न पूछने के बाद छात्र की प्रतिक्रियाओं को प्रोत्साहित करने या किसी विशेष छात्र को बुलाने से पहले बनाए रखता है। वेट टाइम को बढ़ाने से छात्रों को विचार करने, विचारों को व्यवस्थित करने और उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले, विश्लेषणात्मक उत्तर तैयार करने के लिए पर्याप्त संज्ञानात्मक प्रसंस्करण समय मिलता है, जिससे समग्र छात्र भागीदारी में वृद्धि होती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) The pause a teacher takes after asking a question before calling on a student to answer

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Wait time in classroom interaction refers to the intentional pause an educator maintains after posing a question before prompting student responses or calling on an individual.

questions.question_english: Staff development in educational management is distinguished from mere 'training' in that staff development:
options_english: Is a short-term instructional program focused strictly on acquiring a specific, immediate mechanical skill
Is a continuous, holistic process aimed at long-term professional and personal growth
Is a strictly mandatory, top-down administrative compliance measure that carries a punitive contractual nature

questions.explanation_english: Staff development represents a continuous, holistic process aimed at facilitating long-term personal, professional, and pedagogical growth for educators. questions.question_english: Distributed leadership is distinct from simple delegation primarily because it involves:
options_english: Assigning routine, menial administrative tasks and clerical duties to junior teaching personnel
Shared agency, where leadership is emergent and collective rather than top-down task allocation
The institutional Principal entirely giving up and relinquishing all of their formal statutory authority
Systematically rotating the official post and administrative position of Principal among all teachers annually
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that distributed leadership involves shared agency, where leadership emerges collectively rather than through top-down task allocation. This concept fundamentally differs from traditional delegation, which typically involves a top-down transfer of specific tasks from a superior to subordinates. In contrast, distributed leadership relies on mutual influence and collaborative interactions among staff members, allowing leadership dynamics to emerge organically through shared expertise.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। वितरित नेतृत्व में साझा एजेंसी शामिल है, जहां नेतृत्व सामूहिक रूप से उभरता है न कि शीर्ष-नीचे कार्य आवंटन के माध्यम से। यह पारंपरिक प्रतिनिधित्व से भिन्न है, जो आमतौर पर एक वरिष्ठ से अधीनस्थों को विशिष्ट कार्यों का शीर्ष-नीचे हस्तांतरण शामिल करता है।

questions.question_english:
A newly promoted Principal has taken charge of a school where teachers consistently arrive late,
     leave early, and seldom complete the syllabus. The previous Principal adopted a completely hands-off approach.
     The new Principal immediately implements strict attendance monitoring, mandates daily lesson plan submissions,
     and issues memos for non-compliance, heavily relying on positional power. According to situational leadership,
     why is this initial approach best justified?
options_english: The staff demonstrates low readiness (low competence and commitment) requiring a directive (Telling) style.
The staff demonstrates exceptionally high professional readiness and maturity requiring a delegating leadership style.
The Principal intends to gradually transition the institutional climate toward an unstructured laissez-faire culture.
The core principles of transformational leadership mandate taking immediate formal punitive administrative action.
questions.explanation_english: Under Hersey and Blanchard’s Situational Leadership model, an administrator must match leadership behavior to follower readiness. When staff exhibit low competence and low commitment, characterized by tardiness and unfulfilled duties, a directive or telling style (S1) is necessary. High directive oversight establishes clear operational standards and restores administrative discipline.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। हरसी और ब्लैंचर्ड के स्थिति नेतृत्व मॉडल के तहत, एक प्रशासक को नेतृत्व व्यवहार को अनुयायी की तत्परता के साथ मेल करना चाहिए। जब कर्मचारी कम क्षमता और कम प्रतिबद्धता प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जो कि देर से आने और अनपूर्ति कार्यों द्वारा विशेषता होती है, तो एक निर्देशात्मक या बताने वाला शैली (S1) आवश्यक है। उच्च निर्देशात्मक निगरानी स्पष्ट संचालन मानकों की स्थापना करती है और प्रशासनिक अनुशासन को बहाल करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) The staff demonstrates low readiness (low competence and commitment) requiring a directive (Telling) style.
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Hersey and Blanchard’s Situational Leadership model, an administrator must match leadership behavior to follower readiness.
